description: Write in the case file of a disputed task, signed by this server's wallet and encrypted for the parties and the judges: kind "message" (any party or judge), "brief" or "delivery" (a party shares the EXACT text anchored on-chain; it is checked against the chain before sending, and the judges see "matches the chain"), or "request" (a judge asks a party for the brief or the delivery). No files. Costs no gas, but it speaks for the person before the judges: requires an explicit yes from the person.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person approved this exact text.

text.description: The message (max 8000 characters). For "brief" or "delivery", the exact anchored text: leave it out to use the copy this server keeps (brief) or the one it collects from the agent (delivery).

to.description: Judges only: "client" or "worker" for a message or request to one party.

name: panal_dispute_write
